title: Seagrove "Tiger Thyme" 145 Thyme Street
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- 2 blocks from the beach - Private, heated pool, and sitting spa **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $50 per day** The pool and spa are heated together.- Minutes from WaterColor & Seaside- 2 living areas- 8 adult bikes- 4 dedicated parking spots- Low-Speed Vehicle- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, and laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Our "Tiger Thyme" property is conveniently located in the heart of Seagrove Beach, just a few blocks from the beach! With 8 bedrooms/8.5 baths, this extraordinary property is great for big groups or family reunions, with ample room to sleep, 24 guests. Relax in the first-floor open-concept living space, featuring a well-stocked kitchen and dining area. French doors lead to the gorgeous outdoor deck with grilling area and private, heated pool and sitting spa, perfect for outdoor entertaining! A second living space and large great room also provide additional spaces for your large group to gather or entertain. Relax on one of the home's spacious, serene porches, or walk to nearby Seaside for some local shopping and dining! Book today!
